name: Gasthof Kirchenwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Kirchenwirt is located in the municipality of Thiersee in Tirol, Österreich. The accommodation is near the Thiersee and the surrounding mountain landscape. The house presents itself in traditional style and offers a quiet atmosphere. The rooms are simply furnished and practical for a vacation stay. In the surrounding area, activities such as hiking and skiing are possible. The Gasthof has a restaurant area with regional cuisine. Parking and Wi-Fi are available.
